Emerging from their remote planet in the wake of a devastating nuclear blast that wiped out the human colonists on the surface, the Goblins have wasted little time spreading out to nearby worlds and scavenging any technology they find. They are forever seeking new and intriguing life forms and technology, but their penchant for destruction often results in them leaving their new homes every bit as irradiated as their first. The Goblins long dwelt deep beneath the surface of their world, emerging to the surface only in times of desperation to forage and hunt what they could from the surface. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/goblin-reclaimers) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Mischievous: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons. ### Special Rules Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Dangerous Terrain Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Deathstrike(X): If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. Good Shot: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting. Instinctive: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack. Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Retaliate(X): When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Tear: Against units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+4). Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Shooter Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unpredictable Shooter against once (next time the effect would apply). Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. ### Aura Special Rules Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Evasion Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Evasion. Mischievous Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Mischievous Boost. Precision Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee. Quick Shot Aura: This model and its unit get Quick Shot. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Surge. (2): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 2 hits with Blast(3). Shroud Field (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get +1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Pow!
